findings.title: Baseline caution is literal but target-unspecific
findings.statement: Baseline B04 reacts correctly to literal breaking/deprecation language but cannot determine whether those surfaces exist in ModelArrayIO.

findings.title: Exact pytest 9.1.1 identity is proven for latest jobs
findings.statement: The PR changes only pytest in uv.lock and latest tox environments use uv-venv-lock-runner; successful latest jobs therefore exercised pytest 9.1.1.

findings.title: Breaking doctest behavior is inactive
findings.statement: ModelArrayIO does not enable --doctest-modules, so the only pytest 9.1 breaking behavior identified in the official changelog is outside the frozen test path.

findings.title: Deprecated direct surfaces are absent or supported
findings.statement: No listed private API, old hook marker, pastebin, console entry point, yield fixture, teardown getfixturevalue, or class-scoped instance fixture use was found; all parametrization values are concrete Collections.

findings.title: Relevant matrix coverage is broad and clean
findings.statement: Exact-head lock-backed pytest 9.1.1 jobs passed on Python 3.11–3.14, and the Python 3.12 job included downloaded-data tests; the minimum-dependency job also passed.

findings.title: No useful targeted check remains
findings.statement: No unresolved pytest 9.1 target surface names an additional check that would improve the decision. Network S3 tests remain excluded but are not linked to the changed pytest surfaces.

findings.title: Full evidence changes the broad action
findings.statement: The bounded full action is merge_after_normal_review rather than the baseline's run_targeted_checks.

unresolved_questions: External pytest plugin internals were not independently audited.
Network S3 tests were not executed in the public matrix.
current_stop: Stop because the residual limitations do not identify a target-specific pytest 9.1 check and cannot change the bounded action without new evidence.
